question: The spring festival celebrated by Konyak tribe of Nagaland is known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Aoleang Monyu__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aoleang Monyu is the spring festival of Konyak Naga tribe, of Nagaland.**
 
• This may also be called as festival of spring. It is the greatest of all the festivals that **Konyak Naga observes.**
 
• **This Aoleang festival is as old as the people of Konyak.**
 
• It has been observing since the time immemorial.
 
• Konyak Aoleang is observed from **1st-6th April every year.**
